learning_outcomes.text: To understand the basic properties of fluids.
To comprehend the concepts of power and efficiency of hydraulic machines.
Be able to identify various water transfers in pump connections.
To comprehend rules of similarity in hydraulic machines.
Can apply the methods of design and modeling for hydraulic machines.

syllabus_topics: Introduction, power, head and efficiency definitions.
Serial, parallel and hybrid connections of centrifugal pumps.
Similarity, specific speed, the basic concepts.
Similarity, specific speed, the basic concepts.
Construction, characteristics and calculations of centrifugal pumps.
Construction, characteristics and calculations of centrifugal pumps.
Construction, characteristics and calculations of axial pumps.
Construction, characteristics and calculations of axial pumps.
Water turbines, Francis, Kaplan and propeller turbines.
bibliography: B.K. Baysal, Tam Santrifüj Pompalar, İTÜ Yayınları.
C. Özgür, Su Makinaları Dersleri, İTÜ Yayınları.
